newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RTZ-CRA sees no reason to sell Comalco stake.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RTZ-CRA sees no reason to sell Comalco stake.

text.p: RTZ Corp Plc-CRA Ltd said on Thursday it saw no reasaon to sell its 67 percent stake in aluminium producer Comalco Ltd.

Comalco was the group's only business which was not performing in the top quartile of its sector but this was not grounds enough for RTZ-CRA to give up on the company, executive chairman Robert Wilson said in a televised news conference in which he spoke from London.
"That's not a reason, I don't think, to say 'we will cash our chips in at Comalco'," he said.
"Quite the contrary, it is a reason for us to enthusiastically support Comalco in its efforts to improve its cost position," Wilson added.
Comalco earlier this week reported its 1996 net plunged into a A$17.4 million loss from a A$295 million profit in 1995.
